=== cluster/apps/app-production/counta/app.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: counta
  namespace: app-production
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: counta
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: counta
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: dbwait
          image: ghcr.io/example/dbwait:v202601010101@sha256:dbfa1e01dbfa1e01dbfa1e01dbfa1e01dbfa1e01dbfa1e01dbfa1e01dbfa1e01
          command: ["dbwait", "--timeout=60s"]
      containers:
        - name: counta
          image: 'ghcr.io/example/counta:v202602201200@sha256:c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123'
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: counta-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: counta-config
  namespace: app-production
data:
  # Consumed by the app to label its own metrics; not a container image.
  image: ghcr.io/example/counta:v202601151010
  purge_after_days: "90"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: counta
  namespace: app-production
spec:
  selector:
    app: counta
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
=== cluster/apps/app-production/counta/purge-cronjob.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: counta-purge
  namespace: app-production
spec:
  schedule: "15 3 * * *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: purge
              image: ghcr.io/example/counta:v202602201200@sha256:c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123c0c0a123 # keep in step with app.yaml
              command: ["bin/rails", "counta:purge"]

          ports:

=== cluster/apps/app-production/web/app.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: app-production
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: ghcr-pull
      # Production runs three processes from the one image; staging folds queue into worker.
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/example/web:v202602150930@sha256:1f7e5c3a9b2d4e6f8a0c1b3d5e7f9a2b4c6d8e0f1a3b5c7d9e1f2a4b6c8d0e2f
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
          env:
            - name: RAILS_ENV
              value: production
        - name: worker
          image: ghcr.io/example/web:v202602150930@sha256:1f7e5c3a9b2d4e6f8a0c1b3d5e7f9a2b4c6d8e0f1a3b5c7d9e1f2a4b6c8d0e2f
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["bundle", "exec", "good_job", "start"]
        - name: queue
          image: ghcr.io/example/web:v202602150930@sha256:1f7e5c3a9b2d4e6f8a0c1b3d5e7f9a2b4c6d8e0f1a3b5c7d9e1f2a4b6c8d0e2f
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["bundle", "exec", "good_job", "start", "--queues=mail"]
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: app-production
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 3000
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: app-production
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: public
      namespace: gateway
  hostnames:
    - web.example.test
  rules:
    - backendRefs:
        - name: web
          port: 80
